stories.story_title: OpenAI Frontier Models and Codex Launch on AWS
stories.why_this_story: OpenAI models expanding to AWS is a landmark expansion in cloud enterprise infrastructure, making frontier models natively available inside AWS environments and procurement workflows.
stories.viral_angle: The enterprise cloud boundary just dissolved: OpenAI models are no longer tied to one primary cloud path.
stories.story_sentence: Everyone thought building with OpenAI meant navigating isolated API setups or Azure, but OpenAI frontier models and Codex just officially landed on AWS.
stories.story_arc: Hook → Open Loop → Proof → Escalation → Pattern Interrupt → Implication → Payoff

design.visual_strategy: Clean editorial layout with sharp typographic hierarchy, AWS blue accent highlights, structured comparison blocks, and flow diagrams.
design.retention_strategy: Build visual curiosity around how cloud enterprise access is shifting from exclusive environments to multi-cloud deployment.

source_story.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS

slides.headline: OPENAI JUST LANDED ON AWS.
slides.body: For years, deploying OpenAI in enterprise settings meant specific vendor pipelines. That dynamic just shifted completely.
slides.visual_concept: Massive modern grotesk headline with high-contrast background and subtle AWS blue tag accent.
slides.asset_requirement: Typography layout with bold brand metadata.
slides.context: OpenAI announced general availability of its frontier models and Codex on Amazon Web Services.
slides.implication: Enterprise AI deployment friction drops significantly.
slides.swipe_reason: Creates an immediate unanswered question about how enterprise cloud architecture is changing.
slides.psychological_goal: Scroll stop and trigger immediate curiosity.

slides.headline: NO MORE MULTI-CLOUD FRICTION.
slides.body: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now generally available directly within AWS, bringing frontier AI straight to where existing workloads live.
slides.visual_concept: Dual-column comparison showing previous multi-cloud setup vs direct AWS native availability.
slides.context: Enterprises can access OpenAI through the AWS environments they already use.
slides.implication: Reduces legal, procurement, and architectural setup time for enterprise engineering teams.
slides.swipe_reason: Makes the viewer want to understand the exact mechanics of the deployment.
slides.psychological_goal: Establish clear context while maintaining open loop.

slides.headline: BUILT FOR EXISTING AWS WORKFLOWS.
slides.body: Companies can now use existing AWS security controls, governance policies, and procurement channels to run OpenAI frontier models and Codex.
slides.visual_concept: Flow diagram mapping AWS procurement & security directly into OpenAI frontier model access.
slides.asset_requirement: Clean technical diagram with direction arrows and labeled node boxes.
slides.context: Direct integration into existing enterprise billing and security.
slides.swipe_reason: Provides factual structure to validate the initial claim.
slides.psychological_goal: Build credibility through concrete structural proof.

slides.headline: FROM EVALUATION TO PRODUCTION.
slides.body: Instead of running experimental models outside standard infrastructure, teams can now scale directly within their primary enterprise cloud.
slides.visual_concept: Bento container displaying key transition markers: Evaluation phase -> AWS Production workflow.
slides.asset_requirement: Metric container with clean numbers and subtle borders.
slides.implication: Reduces organizational resistance to adopting frontier AI tooling.
slides.swipe_reason: Shows how the technical update changes real-world execution speed.
slides.psychological_goal: Escalate the sense of industry importance.

slides.headline: MODEL ACCESS IS NOW MULTI-CLOUD.
slides.body: The era of locking top-tier frontier models behind single cloud channels is officially closing.
slides.visual_concept: Full dark slide interruption with high-contrast white text and subtle gold rules.
slides.context: Strategic insight into broader AI cloud distribution trends.
slides.implication: Cloud providers must compete on speed, tooling, and infrastructure rather than model exclusivity alone.
slides.swipe_reason: Visually resets eye fatigue while offering a punchy strategic insight.
slides.psychological_goal: Create visual contrast and re-engage swipe momentum.

slides.headline: WHAT THIS MEANS FOR BUILDERS.
slides.body: For developers and enterprise architects, infrastructure choice wins. You no longer have to restructure your cloud stack just to access leading models.
slides.visual_concept: Three-part implication grid highlighting Enterprise Security, Faster Procurement, and Native Integration.
slides.context: Direct benefit breakdown for developers and cloud teams.
slides.implication: AI model accessibility is becoming a horizontal utility across major clouds.
slides.swipe_reason: Answers the 'So What?' question directly for technical readers.
slides.psychological_goal: Provide high-value takeaways and real utility.

slides.headline: THE CLOUD AI WAR JUST ENTERED A NEW PHASE.
slides.body: When frontier AI meets native enterprise cloud infrastructure, implementation speed becomes the ultimate competitive advantage.
slides.visual_concept: Minimalist concluding editorial slide with brand footer mark and subtle gold underline.
slides.asset_requirement: Editorial conclusion layout with minimal footer signature.
slides.context: Final thesis summarizing the cloud evolution.
slides.implication: Multi-cloud AI deployment will become the standard default.
slides.swipe_reason: Leaves the reader with a memorable, shareable conclusion.

stories.caption:
OpenAI frontier models and Codex are officially live on AWS. ☁️⚡️

For years, deploying leading AI models in large enterprises required navigating single-provider channels or custom multi-cloud workarounds. OpenAI's expansion to AWS brings frontier models straight into existing enterprise controls, security environments, and procurement budgets.

Swipe through for the breakdown of what this means for enterprise AI architecture.

—
TESTED • EXPLAINED • REAL
